Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi. Just wondering if this card is stackable? It only says that the
vampire is no longer his original clan. And while I have your
attention, how did the sect rule apply to changing of clans again?

Clan Impersonation
Type: Action
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
Choose a clan and put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire is
considered to be of the chosen clan instead of his or her original
clan (if any). This vampire can burn this card as an action.

Rarity: AH:C2 CE:C

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Baaliprimogen <vegar...@gmail.com> wrote:
>Hi. Just wondering if this card is stackable?

Yes.

Anneke can become Ventrue. Then she can play another Clan Impersonation
and become Lasombra. The Lasombra one applies, until it's burned then -
if the Ventrue one is still there - that applies. The most recently
played one takes precedence over the others.

>It only says that the
>vampire is no longer his original clan. And while I have your
>attention, how did the sect rule apply to changing of clans again?

If you change clan, you take on the default sect for that clan as your
sect.

Lucita (Independent) -> Clan Impersonation (Osebo) -> Lucita, Laibon,
Osebo.

Lucita (Laibon Osebo) burns the Clan Impersonation -> she changes to
Lasombra -> Lucita (SABBAT). (The same would happen if she played a
second Clan Impersonation to Lasombra without burning the first.)

Because she's changed from Osebo to Lasombra, she takes on the default
sect for Lasombra - even though she wasn't that sect originally.

If Lucita is carrying a Writ of Acceptance in the above, her underlying
sect changes as above, but the Writ applies on top. If she loses the
Writ somehow, her underlying sect comes to the fore. So if she lost the
Writ when she was an Osebo, she'd be Laibon. If she lost the Writ after
she'd changed back to Lasombra, she'd be Sabbat.

Playing Clan Impersonation (or any other clan changer) and staying the
same clan *doesn't* affect your sect. So Lucita (Independent Lasombra)
playing Clan Impersonation and choosing Lasombra gets the Clan
Impersonation, but stays Independent. No clan change, therefore no sect
change.
